sloka: न च सीतां दशग्रीवः प्राप्नोति जनकात्मजाम्।बद्धं बलवता वैरमक्षयं राघवेण च ।। ६.९५.१२ ।।
transliteration: na ca sītāṁ daśagrīvaḥ prāpnoti janakātmajām।baddhaṁ balavatā vairamakṣayaṁ rāghaveṇa ca ।। 6.95.12 ।।

translations.english: "For that reason of Surpanakha, this enmity has been conceived by Ravana and Sita was borne away by the ten headed Rakshasa."
